parse.title: Hubris (Day)
parse.text:
Overview

Hubris (Day) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable via evolving Hubris (Night).

Evolving

Hubris (Day) can be evolved from Hubris (Night) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Hubris (Night)
x2 Demonic Chalice
x2 Demonic Horn
x1 Fairy Petals
Result
Hubris (Day)

He can be evolved into Hubris (The One) by having 1,000,000 Sunshine, something he can get by either upon taking down enemies (the later the story/infinite level, the more Sunshine you get), taking down Sunshine Demons on Fabled Kingdom Infinite (or in Portals), or by clearing Fabled Kingdom portals and using Sunshine Essence on him.

  • Note that each Sunshine Essence will give 25,000 Sunshine on the unit.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
